adrien-m-claire-b--time-remap.why_en: Each row of the image comes from a different moment, so a moving body twists into a sculpture of its own past.
adrien-m-claire-b--time-remap.why_zh: 画面的每一行都来自不同的时刻，于是运动的身体扭成了自己过去的雕塑。

adrien-m-claire-b--faune.why_en: Posters on city walls hide animals that only come out when you stop and look through a phone.
adrien-m-claire-b--faune.why_zh: 城墙上的海报里藏着动物，只有停下来用手机看，它们才会出来。

adrien-m-claire-b--acqua-alta-crossing-t.why_en: A paper pop-up book where tiny figures live and drown in an ink flood you can only see through a tablet.
adrien-m-claire-b--acqua-alta-crossing-t.why_zh: 一本纸做的立体书，只有透过平板才能看到里面的小人在墨水洪水中生活、沉没。
